title: Orthodontic Rider Credit — Rider Months Counted by Billing Pattern (Premium Billing Accounts)
content:
**Rule.** For the credit on an ended Orthodontic Benefit Riders rider funded by a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement, the rider months counted follow how the account is billed:

(a) on an arrangement that carries a prepay discount (only Cascade Individual Annual Prepay, at 4 percent) and has issued a twelve-month invoice within twelve months before the credit date, only the prepaid months count — the whole calendar months from the rider's termination date to the account's paid-through date, never fewer than zero — because months beyond the paid-through date are corrected when the coming year is paid; an account with no paid-through date on record is taken under (b) and (c) instead;

(b) failing (a), on an account in a grace period, only the months already begun count — the whole calendar months from the rider's termination date to the credit date, plus one, never fewer than zero;

(c) failing both, the rider months counted are the rider months billed after its end: the whole calendar months from the month after the month of the rider's termination date through the last coverage month of the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first), that month being the invoice's coverage month advanced by its months covered less one; zero when there is no invoice or that month is not later than the termination month.

**Months covered on the credit** are the rider months counted under this rule less the rider months already credited, never fewer than zero. The rider months already credited are the months covered by termination credits on the rider line booked since the rider's termination month; a credit counts as booked since that month when the whole calendar months from its booking date to the credit date are no more than the whole calendar months from the rider's termination date to the credit date.

A record falls within twelve months before the credit date when the whole calendar months from its date to the credit date are fewer than 12. Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it).

**Hypothetical cases** (rider ended 30 April; credit date 12 June; invoice issued last covers June through August).
| Account | Rider months counted |
|---|---|
| Annual Prepay, twelve-month invoice issued in January, paid through 31 December | 30 April to 31 December: 8 |
| Monthly account in a grace period | 30 April to 12 June: 1 complete month, plus one: 2 |
| Quarterly Bill account, active | May through August: 4 |
